title: optmat: curated, validated optical properties of materials
description: optmat provides the optical response of materials for simulations of ultrafast and nonlinear optics, in gases, glasses, crystals and metals: the refractive index and its dispersion from the extreme ultraviolet to the infrared, absorption, the Kerr and third-harmonic coefficients, the Raman response, strong-field ionisation rates and two-photon cross sections. Every value is traceable to the paper, table and page it came from, and a public review register records how the data were checked.
